Compute credible interval on betting edge

Source: R/models_brms.R
edge_credible_interval.Rd

For each posterior draw, computes edge = model_prob - market_prob. Returns the median edge and 95% credible interval. A bet where the entire CI is positive is more reliable than one where it spans zero.

Usage

edge_credible_interval(prob_draws, market_prob, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

Arguments

prob_draws

Numeric vector. Posterior draws of predicted probability.

market_prob

Numeric scalar. Market-implied probability (from devigged odds).

probs

Numeric vector. Quantiles for credible interval (default c(0.025, 0.975)).

Value

A tibble with columns edge_median, edge_lower, edge_upper, pct_positive.
